explanation: Highly elastic (e=1) high-speed collision with large mass ratio causes energy gain. At step 11 bodies approach with combined kinetic energy consistent with E0~24017 J, but after substepped collision at step 12 energy jumps to ~26977 J exceeding E0*1.1+5. Lowering restitution to 0.5 eliminates violation, indicating impulse/positional correction adds energy in elastic case.
